# Workbench operation tools

[Feature reference](../README.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/workbench-tools.mjs. Run `make docs-tools` after an operation change. Do not edit by hand. -->

An agent of a Workbench session can call 127 KanthorD operations as tools. 53 of them change state and wait for the approval of the human. [How the native agent works](../../explanation/native-agent.md#tools) explains the selection rule and the exclusions.

The tool name is the operation id with each `.` replaced by `--`. A tool runs with the identity of the human who sent the last message.

| Service | Tools | Change state |
| ------- | ----- | ------------ |
| [Agent](#agent) | 16 | 9 |
| [Gateway](#gateway) | 2 | 0 |
| [LLM](#llm) | 11 | 4 |
| [Mission](#mission) | 41 | 20 |
| [Project](#project) | 20 | 7 |
| [Repository](#repository) | 9 | 3 |
| [Scheduler](#scheduler) | 4 | 0 |
| [Storage](#storage) | 7 | 3 |
| [Workbench](#workbench) | 8 | 5 |
| [Worker](#worker) | 9 | 2 |

## Agent

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `agent--cooldown--clear` | `DELETE /api/agent/cooldown/:credential` | Yes | Clear the cooldown of one credential copy so that the next claim can select its chain entries again. The holder defaults to server. |
| `agent--cooldown--list` | `GET /api/agent/cooldown` | No | List the credential copies that hold a cooldown, live and expired, ordered by credential name and holder. |
| `agent--enablement--disable` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name/disable` | Yes | Disable an agent enablement without validating dependent bindings. |
| `agent--enablement--enable` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name/enable` | Yes | Validate and enable an existing agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--get` | `GET /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name` | No | Get a live agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--list` | `GET /api/agent/enablement` | No | List agent enablements in ascending agent-name order. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--add` | `POST /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name/provider` | Yes | Append a named provider to an agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--model--list` | `GET /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name/provider/:provider_name/model` | No | List the models and reasoning efforts of one agent provider of an agent enablement. |
| `agent--enablement--provider--remove` | `DELETE /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name/provider/:provider_name` | Yes | Remove an unused named provider, retaining at least one provider. |
| `agent--enablement--put` | `PUT /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name` | Yes | Create or replace an agent enablement at its expected revision. |
| `agent--enablement--remove` | `DELETE /api/agent/enablement/:agent_name` | Yes | Remove an agent enablement with no dependent bindings. |
| `agent--get` | `GET /api/agent/:agent_name` | No | Get an agent declaration, its current enablement and the chain view of that enablement. |
| `agent--model--list` | `GET /api/agent/model` | No | List the models and reasoning efforts of one credential for one agent provider kind, before an enablement names it. |
| `agent--prompt--get` | `GET /api/agent/prompt` | No | Read the switches, the custom text and the system layer override of one prompt scope. |
| `agent--prompt--put` | `PUT /api/agent/prompt` | Yes | Replace the custom text of one prompt scope at its expected revision. |
| `agent--prompt--switch` | `POST /api/agent/prompt/switch` | Yes | Set one switch of one prompt scope, or the system layer override of one agent scope, at its expected revision. |

## Gateway

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `gateway--healthcheck` | `GET /api/healthcheck` | No | Check resource health on demand, grouped by owner and scope. Returns every inventory entry with status and capability, including unknown for unfinished checks. A missing inventory returns 503 with missing_inventories in error.details. |
| `gateway--verify` | `GET /api/auth/verify` | No | Verify the human bearer JWT and return its kind, sub and name claims without aliases, the token or token metadata. |

## LLM

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `llm--credential--archive` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credential_name/archive` | Yes | Archive one copy of an LLM credential that no dependent names. The holder defaults to server. |
| `llm--credential--get` | `GET /api/llm/credential/:credential_name` | No | Get one copy of an LLM credential, all its revisions and the agent providers that name it. The holder defaults to server for a human and to the instance of a worker token. |
| `llm--credential--list` | `GET /api/llm/credential` | No | List the copies of LLM credentials with optional platform and holder filtering and pagination. A worker instance lists only its own copies. |
| `llm--credential--login` | `POST /api/llm/credential/login` | Yes | Start an OAuth credential login session. The holder defaults to server. A login of a worker instance runs on that instance in copy_code or device mode. A login of an instance copy that is sealed to an ended key adds the next revision of that copy. |
| `llm--credential--login_status` | `GET /api/llm/credential/login/:session_id` | No | Read the state of an OAuth login session. |
| `llm--credential--platform_list` | `GET /api/llm/credential/platform` | No | List the LLM credential platforms. |
| `llm--credential--revoke` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credential_name/revision/:revision/revoke` | Yes | End an older revision of one copy of an LLM credential. The holder defaults to server. |
| `llm--credential--update_metadata` | `PUT /api/llm/credential/:credential_name/metadata` | Yes | Update the metadata of one copy of an LLM credential in a new revision. The holder defaults to server. |
| `llm--credential--verify` | `POST /api/llm/credential/:credential_name/verify` | No | Verify one stored llm credential record. |
| `llm--model--check` | `POST /api/llm/model/check` | No | Check one tool round trip of a model and a reasoning effort through an LLM credential. |
| `llm--provider--check` | `POST /api/llm/provider/check` | No | Check the connection of an LLM credential through its LLM provider and read its model list when the check reads one. |

| `project--pause` | `POST /api/project/:project_id/pause` | Yes | Pause a project so that it admits no claim. |
| `project--rename` | `PATCH /api/project/:project_id` | Yes | Rename a project. |
| `project--resume` | `POST /api/project/:project_id/resume` | Yes | Resume a paused project so that it admits claims. |

## Workbench

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `workbench--session--abort` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:session_id/abort` | Yes | Stop the active run of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--approve` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:session_id/approve` | Yes | Approve or reject the pending call of a mutation tool of the active run. |
| `workbench--session--configure` | `PUT /api/workbench/session/:session_id/configuration` | Yes | Replace the configuration of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--create` | `POST /api/workbench/session` | Yes | Create a workbench session with one agent of the catalog. |
| `workbench--session--events` | `GET /api/workbench/session/:session_id/events` | No | Answer the session entries after `after` and the snapshot of the active run at once when `version` differs, else wait up to 25 seconds for a change. |
| `workbench--session--get` | `GET /api/workbench/session/:session_id` | No | Get the configuration, the entries of the completed runs and the run state of a workbench session. |
| `workbench--session--list` | `GET /api/workbench/session` | No | List the workbench sessions of every agent, or of one agent. Each item also answers `run_active` and `pending_approval` of the in-memory run. |
| `workbench--session--message` | `POST /api/workbench/session/:session_id/message` | Yes | Start a run of the agent on one human message. A session holds one run at a time. |

## Worker

| Tool | Route | Approval | Description |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `worker--catalog--get` | `GET /api/worker/catalog/:worker_name` | No | Get a supplied worker declaration. |
| `worker--catalog--list` | `GET /api/worker/catalog` | No | List released workers in ascending worker-name order. |
| `worker--instance--archive` | `POST /api/worker/instance/:instance_name/archive` | Yes | Archive a worker instance that no binding lists and whose registrations hold no live execution, and end its registrations. |
| `worker--instance--get` | `GET /api/worker/instance/:instance_name` | No | Read the live or latest revision of a worker instance with the bindings that list it, its connection, its live registrations and its credential copies with the last health report of each copy. |
| `worker--instance--list` | `GET /api/worker/instance` | No | Page worker instances in ascending name order with their connection, binding count and holder mismatch. |
| `worker--placement--list` | `GET /api/worker/placement` | No | List each worker placement with its availability on this server and the reason when it is unavailable, in the order server, container, worker. |
| `worker--registration--get` | `GET /api/worker/registration/:runtime_identity` | No | Read a live registration record. Unknown and ended registrations answer not found. |
| `worker--registration--list` | `GET /api/worker/registration` | No | Page live registrations in descending runtime identity order without changing runtime state. |
| `worker--registration--resume` | `POST /api/worker/registration/:runtime_identity/resume` | Yes | Resume an ended registration with a running execution and an available slot. A live registration is unchanged. |
